pci.attachment: NONE; V100 BDF filled from a fresh inspected single-device group only after separate approval.

disk.candidate: Fresh uniquely named qcow2 overlay and NVRAM copy, after approval; hash originals before and after.
disk.guest_image_mutation: Candidate overlay only; keep failed overlays and evidence.

firmware.admission: Reconcile existing guest secure-boot state and driver-signature evidence. No switching firmware or weakening enforcement to make driver load.

network.port_rule: Recheck unoccupied port without replacing an existing listener.

qmp.authorization: Only independently supervised session owner can stop this exact VM.

rollback: Stop only exact owned candidate worker/VM using independently verified custody, confirm guest work ceased.
After explicit approval and no outstanding DMA, restore only V100 to recorded prior unbound state and clear only the override this session set.
Leave RTX 5080 driver and display untouched. Preserve original disk, backing image, NVRAM, candidate overlay and all evidence.
If reset/unbind fails, stop automation and report; no retry, host reboot or global driver unload without new approval.
not_proven: Guest boot with current exact overlay and firmware
Actual independent guest cessation within five-second reserve
